title: pilosella velutella
intro: Pilosella velutella, commonly known as Mouse-ear Hawkweed, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion tribe within the sunflower family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in treating various health issues such as wound healing, skin conditions, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella velutella are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which exert antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. However, further research is needed to fully understand the plant's therapeutic potential and to establish its safety and efficacy for human use.
